_notes: Entered by hand from Table 3 of the published 2023 AGS Beers Criteria (drugs to avoid in older adults with certain diseases or syndromes). This is a partial list, the wording is paraphrased, and every entry and every drug name MUST be verified against the published table before anyone relies on it. Drugs whose name alone cannot separate a flagged form from an unflagged one (for example oral vs. topical, or a dose threshold) were left out on purpose. An absent flag does not mean a medication is safe. Not medical advice.

sources.beers-2023-table-3: American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2023;71(7):2052-2081. Table 3.
